title: Replacing Kitchen Countertops: Digital Template, Silicone Bonding, and Appliance Hookups (This Old House)
summary: This Old House walks through a small kitchen remodel focused on countertop replacement and appliance reinstallation. The crew begins by removing the old stove and disconnecting water, drain, and electrical lines to clear the workspace. They contrast a traditional countertop templating method with a digital system that uses taped templates and CAD-based measurement to achieve precise dimensions. The new solid-surface countertops are installed with silicone to allow thermal expansion, secured with pony clamps and a vacuum clamp system for a tight, level seam, and paired with a matching three-piece backsplash. The video then covers reconnecting the water supply and drain, installing the disposal and hood fan (including hard-wiring), wiring the dishwasher (water, drain, and electrical connections), and finally mounting and testing the electric range.
topics: tape template across counters and walls
pon y clamps for seam alignment
vacuum clamp system for seam pulling
dishwasher water supply hookup (copper line, compression nut, ferrule)

sections.title: Prep and appliance removal
concepts: shut off water and drain lines
sections.description: The crew begins by removing the old stove to gain room to work, while shutting off hot and cold water and breaking the drain connections. They outline the plan to replace countertops but preserve the existing cabinets for painting later.

sections.title: Countertop templating: traditional vs digital
sections.description: After removing countertops, the team explains the old method of making a perimeter template from plywood strips and hot glue, then contrasts it with a contemporary digital system. A countertop company used tape across the area, photographed with a digital camera, then used CAD to determine kitchen dimensions with approximately 1/16 inch accuracy.

sections.title: First countertop installation and seam work
sections.description: The first countertop section arrives. It is a polyester/resin solid-surface material in a chosen color. The countertop is seated onto the cabinets using silicone dabs to permit independent expansion and contraction. Pony clamps are applied to align the seam, and a vacuum clamp system is employed to pull pieces together and level the seam before curing.

sections.title: Backsplash, water, exhaust, and appliance hookups
concepts: copper supply line with compression and ferrule
sections.description: The crew confirms use of the same solid-surface material for the backsplash, then reconnects hot and cold water. They install the disposal and mount the hood fan under the cabinet, wiring it in. The dishwasher is connected via a copper water line (compression nut and ferrule), a drain hose to the pump, and electrical connections with wire nuts. Finally, the range is plugged in, tested, and confirmed with a description of its features (five burners, two ovens).
